obs.studio.description: Connects to OBS Studio via WebSocket v5 for live audio VU meters, scene/mute/volume events, and remote control.

scene.label: Set Scene
scene.description: Switches the active OBS program scene to the payload string (or Default Scene if empty).

volume.label: Set Volume
volume.description: Sets input volume for Audio Input (or properties.inputName) using the selected Volume Scale.

mute.label: Mute / Toggle
mute.description: Sets explicit mute state on true/false, or toggles mute on any other payload.

command.label: Raw Request
command.description: Sends an arbitrary OBS WebSocket v5 request (string or { requestType, requestData }).

vuLevel.label: VU Level (0..100)
vuLevel.description: Emits live audio level percentage (0..100) with stereo leftPercent/rightPercent and db properties.

sceneChanged.label: Scene Changed
sceneChanged.description: Emits the new program scene name whenever the active scene changes in OBS.

muteChanged.label: Mute Changed
muteChanged.description: Emits boolean mute state whenever a matching audio input is muted or unmuted.

volumeChanged.label: Volume Changed
volumeChanged.description: Emits the updated volume value (in the chosen Volume Scale) when a matching input changes.

status.label: Status / Response
status.description: Emits connection events, stream/record state changes, raw request responses, and errors.

enabled.label: Connect
enabled.description: Enable or disable the OBS WebSocket connection.

host.label: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the OBS WebSocket server.

port.label: Port
port.description: TCP port of the OBS WebSocket v5 server (default 4455).

password.label: Password
password.description: OBS WebSocket server password (leave empty if authentication is disabled).

audioSource.label: Audio Input
audioSource.description: Default OBS audio input name for volume/mute commands and event filtering (empty = all inputs).

sceneName.label: Default Scene
sceneName.description: Fallback scene name used when an empty payload arrives on the Set Scene input.

subscribeMeters.label: Audio VU Meters
subscribeMeters.description: Subscribe to high-volume OBS InputVolumeMeters events for live VU output.

meterThrottleMs.label: VU Interval (ms)
meterThrottleMs.description: Minimum interval in milliseconds between VU emissions per audio source (0 = unthrottled).

volumeScale.label: Volume Scale
volumeScale.description: Numeric unit used by the Set Volume input and Volume Changed output.
